summary.headline: Astrological Omens and Zodiacal Ascensions
summary.text: Catalogue of folio 277–289v material on Persian beginnings, rainbow indications, two astrological themata including Constantinople and Eleutherios Zebelenos, star and place movements, death prognostics, thunder and earthquake omens, and zodiacal rulers and ascensions. Authorities cited include Demophilos, John Laurentius Lydus, Roman Figulus, Hermes Trismegistus, and Vicellius.
